name: v6_backup_corrupt_or_unknown_schema_refused
boundary: restore of a corrupted backup and of an unknown-schema manifest
seed_method: packaged hooks seed a store; daemon stopped; a valid backup is taken; then one tree file is tampered and, separately, the manifest schema is bumped beyond this build; each restore is aimed at its own fresh destination
reason: a corrupted or unknown-schema restore did not fail, or it published a destination store
